description.value:
The engineered underclass - short, sturdy, unbreakable, and done being looked down on. Centuries ago the megacorps engineered the Corran (Homo sapiens fossor) as a laborer breed - compact, immensely strong and hardy, built to work the deep mines and cramped service crawls no baseline human could survive. Hundreds of years on they are a fully distinct species with their own communities, dialects, guild-clans, and culture. The corps still read them as "just labor"; the Corran repay it with deep solidarity, long memory, and a chip on the shoulder the size of a mine cart. Slang: Squats, Deepers, dust-eaters.

Attribute Profile: +1 Physique, +1 Resolve, -1 Reflex.

Signature Trait - Unyielding: the iconic, always-on Corran trait - the immovable laborer who does not budge (encoded below as two linked traits: Footing and Refusal).
